selection_rules: No model predictions used in scene/target/view selection
Document all technical failures, visibility exclusions and label corrections
Do not silently substitute frozen scenes
Use both mask and visible-box scores plus fixed-center baseline

rendering.process_policy: one isolated process per scene/condition; new render product for each view
rendering.view_order: same final frozen ordered views for both conditions
rendering.status: matched-workflow repeatability qualified; formal images still require QA

visibility_policy.selection_population: qualify and freeze original-condition targets/views before model inference
visibility_policy.converted_visibility_loss: retain technically valid converted images with empty target masks; report visibility loss separately
visibility_policy.primary_denominator: all original-qualified paired queries; visible-mask end-to-end task success
visibility_policy.secondary_analysis: both-visible subset with the same IDs for both conditions; do not attribute visibility loss to model reasoning errors
visibility_policy.infrastructure_failure: separate status, repair/retry exact input; never score as task miss
visibility_policy.selection_note: Pilot used both-visible qualification; formal population differs and must not be pooled with pilot

render_qualification.fresh_vs_batch_equivalence: not established; preserve measured differences, do not mix pipelines
render_qualification.matched_workflow: same ordered camera list and settings for O/C, final recapture after view selection
render_qualification.repeatability_gate: independent identical batch runs: masks equal and RGB MAE <= 1 intensity level; pending
render_qualification.render_noise_control: after qualification, repeat full final batches for 3 deterministically selected formal scenes (2 home/1 commercial), separately from 5760 primary predictions
